notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
A small patch today.

System
A small fix to account for possible corrupted Arial font files on windows 10 machines.

If your font fails to load the game should now use a different font instead.

notes.title: Minor Fix
notes.notes:
Just a couple of small fixes.

System 
Interface should no longer tell you 'that's not a valid number' every time you start a conversation.

Level
Act 2 - Clones of Thorahk will no longer re-appear in caves you've already completed, and as a result won't offer you any game crashing dialogue.

As with the previous patch, system changes should effect your games immediately, level changes will probably only take effect on a new game.

Note: The Act 2 issues addressed here were in no way preventing you from completing a successful game.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Release Build 1.0.3
notes.notes:
A bit of a combination of a few updates here over night, but here's the gist of it.

Level/Room Based Changes
Player Defence adjusted, now displaying and functioning correctly.
Minor level adjustments, connecting a faulty room.
Adjusted some items in the world to have the correct slot types.
Adjusted Shock and Smash to bring them closer in line to Barrage.
Adjusted some boss stats.

System Based Changes
Removed Regen step check
Regen now on a global two minute timer.
All mob groups now re spawn globally on regen timer.
(This was to fix an issue causing monsters to stop re-spawning for a few hours from Act3 onward.)

If you aren't too far through we recommend starting a new game to get the most out of all of the level/room based changes. The game is completely playable without it, but some items, (ritual hat - equip will cause a crash) (ancient focussing lens - equips to wrong slot) won't work correctly, and shock and smash might feel a bit weak.

System changes should take instant effect without the need to start again.

Thank you all for playing!

notes.title: A Gentlemanly Adventure is live!
notes.notes:
We've finally released the game! It's up and ready for download. We hope you enjoy playing it.

Currently live for windows and linux, we are working on a functioning mac build for the future.

Thank you!

notes.title: A slight delay.
notes.notes:
We are still working hard on the game!
Play-testing has been going well, and the balance is just about where we want it.
There were a couple of systems that we haven't quite nailed down as quickly as we had hoped, so unfortunately our release schedule has had to be bumped back a little. I will aim a bit further away and say we should hopefully be finished before late October.

notes.title: Development Update - August 2018
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! Thanks for taking an interest in the game, we are still hard at work getting it ready for launch next month, and I think we are still right on track.
Here's a brief look at what we've been up to.

Implementing the Modding system has been going along smoothly. We've realized a need to separate art assets between modules more, and have done so. As a result, any user made modules will show a lot more individuality.

The map system has been re-worked to be far more robust, maps are being created accordingly to give people a much better idea of where they are in the game.

Testing and ability tweaking and bug fixing is ongoing.

I'm very excited about how the mod system is looking, and hopefully you will all get a good kick out of using it.
